title: Mid-Term Endorsements and Their Premium — NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own)
content:
## Mid-term endorsements on NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own)

**Kinds of endorsement.** A mid-term endorsement is recorded as one of: Coverage Increase, Deductible Decrease, Mortgagee Change, Coverage Decrease at Renewal, or Deductible Increase at Renewal.

**Status.** An endorsement is processed only on a policy whose status is pending effective or in force. The status read is the one on Tidemark's policy record for that policy, before the endorsement is processed.

**Coverage increase or deductible decrease.** The rating engine returns the full-term risk premium and ICC premium for the policy as endorsed, and the additional premium is booked as endorsement components. *Clause no longer in force:* "the risk premium component is the increase in the full-term risk premium and the ICC premium component is the increase in the full-term ICC premium". This clause is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis. Each of those two amounts is multiplied by the days from the endorsement effective date to the term end divided by the days from the term start to the term end, and rounded to the cent, and the Reserve Fund Assessment component is the tier's Reserve Fund Assessment percentage of those two pro rata amounts, rounded to the cent. The endorsement effective date follows the waiting-period rule.

**Mortgagee change.** A Mortgagee Change takes effect on the date it is recorded and carries no premium.

**Changes at renewal.** A Coverage Decrease at Renewal or a Deductible Increase at Renewal takes effect on the next term start and changes premium only through the renewal booking; no mid-term credit is given for it.

| Endorsement | Takes effect | Premium |
|---|---|---|
| Coverage Increase | Per the waiting-period rule | Endorsement components on the risk premium, ICC premium and Reserve Fund Assessment lines, pro rata to the term end |
| Deductible Decrease | Per the waiting-period rule | As for a coverage increase |
| Mortgagee Change | The date it is recorded | None |
| Coverage Decrease at Renewal | The next term start | Only through the renewal booking; no mid-term credit |
| Deductible Increase at Renewal | The next term start | Only through the renewal booking; no mid-term credit |

| Policy status on the record | Endorsement |
|---|---|
| Pending effective | Processed |
| In force | Processed |
| Renewal grace, lapsed, cancelled or nullified | Not processed |

*Hypothetical pro rata step.* For an amount of 365.00 dollars on a term of 365 days, an endorsement effective with 73 days left to the term end gives 365.00 multiplied by 73 and divided by 365, that is 73.00 dollars; the Reserve Fund Assessment component at a hypothetical 18 percent of that pro rata amount would be 13.14 dollars.

superseded_clauses: the RISK_PREMIUM component is the increase in the full-term risk premium and the ICC_PREMIUM component is the increase in the full-term ICC premium
